newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Earthquake jolts Indonesia's Sumatra, no damage.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake jolts Indonesia's Sumatra, no damage.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.5 on the Richter scale hit Bengkulu province on Indonesia's western Sumatra island on Tuesday but there were no immediate reports of damage or casualties, a meteorology official said.

"The quake hit Bengkulu at 12:55 p.m. local time (0555 GMT) this afternoon with the epicentre located on land about 100 km (62.5 miles) miles north of Bengkulu city," the official told Reuters by telephone.
Residents in Bengkulu city said they felt the tremor and that people rushed from their houses during the quake. They said they did not hear any reports of damage.

The Royal Hong Kong Observatory said earlier a strong earthquake measuring 5.6 on the Richter scale hit the southern part of Indonesia's western Sumatra island on Tuesday afternoon, but there were no immediate reports of damage or casualties.
